summary: Practise source-level methane measurement, Tier 3 estimates and MRV evidence checks. Review the five-day course outline and assess fit for your team.
lede: Upstream methane measurement training helps emissions engineers, measurement specialists and operations teams plan asset-specific fieldwork and reporting. Participants practise selecting measurement approaches, checking instrument data quality and estimating source-level emissions from field records. They also learn to document measurement conditions, screen uncertainty and connect results to traceable evidence, while keeping IPCC Tier 3 inventory methods distinct from OGMP 2.0 reporting levels.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, conduct, review or use methane measurements across upstream assets and facilities.
prerequisites: Intermediate course. You should have working familiarity with upstream oil and gas operations and methane emissions inventories. Coding is not required; exercises focus on measurement records, field procedures and calculation logic.
